comparison.objective: Install an IT support bracket in a rack, versus level a rack shelf by relocating one pull pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate proposes whole-bracket multi-feature alignment/latching; PR extracts, aligns, and reseats one load-support pin while preserving three others.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct OpenU and all unknown mounts engaged; PR requires four pins seated at level 2 and the shelf level, with movement limits on the other pins.
comparison.reason: Both concern rack support registration and retention, and the candidate’s undisclosed interface prevents ruling out the same pin/hole ability.
